notes.intro: The first version of Encode: smaller videos, nothing else changed. It re-encodes only the picture to H.265 and copies every audio track, subtitle and chapter as it is. Signed and notarized by Apple; it offers new versions when you open it.
Re-encodes oversized H.265 and AV1 files; files that are already compact are still kept as they are.
Progress now shows correctly for Blu-ray files with sparse subtitle tracks.
